title: Describe native access scope
responsibility: Explain the project access requested by a native device before approval.

inputs.name: nativeScope.resource
inputs.description: Selects the requested native project scope. The exact value `projects` covers every shared project; `project:<id>` is narrowed only when its suffix is nonempty, while null, other text, and an empty suffix are treated as an unspecified broad request.

inputs.name: nativeScope.projects
inputs.description: Provides `get` for nonempty `project:<id>` selectors; its resolved project supplies the name in the response. Lookup or name-conversion failures are caught and reported as an inaccessible project.

outputs.name: nativeScope
outputs.description: Resolves to a user-facing description of the requested scope. It names every shared project (now and later) for `projects`, a resolved project name only for a nonempty `project:<id>` whose lookup succeeds, one inaccessible project after lookup failure, and every shared project when the selector is null, unrecognized, or has an empty ID.
examples: every shared project you can open, now and later
one project that this account cannot open
